explication: Zephyr is a scalable, security-focused RTOS for resource-constrained devices, with support for many processor architectures and boards. A typical application uses kernel services and hardware-facing drivers; higher-level subsystems provide facilities such as LwM2M, LoRaWAN, Bluetooth media control, and firmware update storage. The supplied excerpts show several subsystem internals, but not a complete application-to-kernel execution path, so cross-component links without direct evidence are omitted. The graph reflects the documented product scope and sampled components, not a full runtime call map.
